text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Mejiro Dober! You were

awesome—just incredible! That was an
amazing
run!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I've fulfilled my promise and watched
over your
classic year, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The next time we meet, you and I will
be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It's over. The Triple Tiara is over.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I don't regret anything. After all, I ran
without
holding anything back.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(So many people supported me
throughout this.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't cry... I have to stay strong for
their sake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober leaves the crowd behind,
and I
head out to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I may not have won the Triple Tiara, but
I'm
satisfied with how things turned out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I did. That's why I can be proud of what I
did...
and why I can move forward too.
